title: Sebastian and the House
author: Wendell Almeida
blurb: Ivo Thackeray, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must get the family out ahead of the count before the well refills.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
